title: How Skipping One Meal a Week Teaches a Godly Man to Say No
caption:
Jesus said "when you fast," not "if." One skipped meal a week is a small place to learn that your hunger doesn't get to run you.

If you have a medical condition, talk to your doctor first. Save this and try it this week.

#faith #fasting #godlyman #selfcontrol #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
